newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Christopher arrives in Ethiopia on Africa tour.
newsitem.headline: Christopher arrives in Ethiopia on Africa tour.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher arrived in Ethiopia's capital on Wednesday to press for a 10,000-strong African force for use in humanitarian crises and for a new African candidate for U.N. secretary-general.

On the first visit by a secretary of state to sub-Saharan Africa for more than six years, Christopher arrived in the hilly Ethiopian capital Addis Ababa from Mali where he began his five -nation African tour on Monday.
